翻译成中文：Commit e4df4f6[REDACTED-USER-ID]
[REDACTED-USER-ID]
committed
16 minutes ago
feat(bk7258): reset the chip from the AP, so reboot takes 0.5s not 8.3s
The AP could not reset the board at all: there was no CONFIG_BOARDCTL_RESET
here, so NSH's `reboot` was not even built, and every reset in the
development loop went through the CP shell instead (autoflash.sh and
serial_cmd.sh both do, because this board has no auto-reset circuit on
DTR/RTS -- pulsing either line produces zero bytes, re-measured).


That CP path is slow, and measurably so.  Three runs, identical to the
millisecond: from the `reboot` echo to the CP's first boot line is 8.373s,
of which the CP's own uptime counter says only ~110ms is bootrom plus
bootloader.  8000ms is CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS in the CP build: the CP's
`reboot` ends in bk_wdt_force_reboot(), which with CONFIG_NMI_WDT_EN=1 takes
an NMI rather than a reset, and the NMI lands in the two-core dump handover
in cp/middleware/arch/cm33/trap_base.c that our AP does not participate in.
Nothing resets the part until the interrupt watchdog expires.


board_reset() arms the AON watchdog with the same two-stage key and 10-tick
period the vendor's own non-NMI branch uses (wdt_hal_force_reboot()), so
there is no NMI, no dump handover and nobody to wait for.  Asking the CP
over the mailbox would not have helped: its IPC_CPU1_NEED_REBOOT handler
calls the same bk_wdt_force_reboot().


Measured after this, five runs: console output returns at 0.52s, the
greeting is complete at 2.07-2.17s and NSH prompts at 2.18-2.29s, against
10.0s and 10.14s before.

feat(bk7258): 从AP侧复位芯片，使重启从8.3s降至0.5s

AP之前完全无法复位开发板：缺少CONFIG_BOARDCTL_RESET，导致NSH的`reboot`根本无法构建，开发循环中的每次复位都得走CP shell（autoflash.sh和serial_cmd.sh都是如此，因为这块板子在DTR/RTS上没有自动复位电路——脉冲任一线都输出零字节，已重新测量）。

CP路径很慢，且可量化。三次运行，精确到毫秒级：从`reboot`回显到CP的第一行启动日志耗时8.373s，其中CP自身的运行计时器显示仅~110ms是bootrom加bootloader。8000ms来自CP构建中的CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS：CP的`reboot`最终调用bk_wdt_force_reboot()，在启用CONFIG_NMI_WDT_EN=1时触发的是NMI而非复位，NMI落入cp/middleware/arch/cm33/trap_base.c中的双核转储交接逻辑，而我们的AP并未参与其中。直到中断看门狗超时，芯片才会复位。

board_reset()使用与厂商非NMI分支（wdt_hal_force_reboot()）相同的两阶段密钥和10-tick周期来武装AON看门狗，因此不会产生NMI、不会转储交接、无需等待任何人。通过邮箱请求CP也无济于事：其IPC_CPU1_NEED_REBOOT处理程序调用的是同一个bk_wdt_force_reboot()。

修改后测量，五次运行：控制台输出在0.52s恢复，欢迎信息在2.07-2.17s完成，NSH提示符在2.18-2.29s出现，而此前分别为10.0s和10.14s。
